text:
I do not want the curved pipe,

nor your embroidered handkerchief,

nor the roses on Sundays,

nor the little basket with fish.


And I will leave this port

for another distant port

so that you cannot say:

The fisherwoman is my lover!

translation.title: The Fisherwoman
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fisherwoman's refusal as a clean escape from being claimed.
